hi love, hi love. i know life has been really hard on you lately, and i know there might be times when everything feels too heavy and you don't even know where to start or how to handle everything that's happening rn. and that's okay, love. it's okay if you don't have all the answers right now. it's okay if you're tired, or even if you feel like you're not doing enough. you don't always have to be strong, and you don't have to pretend that everything is okay when it really isn't.
it's okay to feel tired, love, okay? ;) you've been trying your best, even on days when things don't go the way you want them to. and even if you feel like you're not making any progress, please don't be too hard on yourself. sometimes, just getting through the day is already something to be proud of. you don't have to do everything perfectly, and you don't have to figure everything out in one day. take your time po, love. okayii?
if you feel like crying, then cry, love. don't keep everything to yourself just because you think you have to be strong all the time. let it all out po, okay? you don't have to hide your feelings or act like nothing hurts. whatever you're feeling right now is valid love, and you have every right to feel that way. you don't need to explain why you're tired just to prove that you've been going through something difficult. i hope you allow yourself to rest whenever you need to, because you deserve that too.
whether today feels good or bad, tuloy lang po, love okay. and when i say tuloy lang, i don't mean that you have to keep pushing yourself even when you're already exhausted. sometimes, moving forward means taking a break, breathing for a while, and giving yourself time to feel everything. (wow hahaha) it's okay to slow down when things get overwhelming. it's okay to take a step back and rest before trying again. you don't have to rush yourself just because life keeps moving. you have your own pace, love, and that's okay
i know i can't always make the things you're going through disappear, and i know there are some things that you have to face on your own. but i hope you know that you don't have to carry everything in silence. you can always talk about what's bothering you, and you can tell me when things get too heavy. you don't have to find the right words, and you don't have to explain everything perfectly. even if all you can say is that you're tired, that's okay, love.
and most importantly, love, god is always by your side. :) even during the days when everything feels uncertain, when your heart feels heavy, or when you don't understand why things are happening the way they are, i hope you find comfort in knowing that you're never forgotten. you can always pray, even if you don't know what to say. you can tell him everything that's on your mind and everything that's hurting your heart. trust his timing, love
i hope tomorrow feels a little lighter for you, love. and if it doesn't, that's okay too. you don't have to force yourself to be happy just because it's a new day. take things slowly and allow yourself to feel whatever you need to feel.
so please take care of yourself po, love. eat when you can, drink your water, get enough rest, and don't forget to breathe when everything feels overwhelming. don't put too much pressure on yourself, okay?
tuloy lang po, love, but don't forget to rest along the way, okay;) you don't have to be strong every second of every day. just take things one day at a time, and trust that you'll get through this little by little. god is always with you,
sana bago mo 'to mabasa lahat love sana ay napagaaan ko yung pakiramdam mo, love. please remember to be gentle with yourself, especially when life isn't being gentle with you. you're doing better than you think, and i'm really hoping that things get easier for you soon. sending you the big biggg hugs, love. take your time and rest when you need to okayii everything will be okay.
I LOVE YOU ALLWAYS IN ALL WAYS, MAHAL KO;> PROUD AKO SAYO PALAGI! ♡
